what: Get Data for Brazilian Bonds (Tesouro Direto)
title: Get Data for Brazilian Bonds (Tesouro Direto)
text: Information regarding prices yields bonds issued Brazilian government can downloaded manually excel files Tesouro Direto website. However, painful aggregate data something useful several files don’t uniform format. Package GetTDData makes process importing data Tesouro direto much easier. need order download data name assets (LFT, LTN, NTN-C, NTN-B, NTN-B Principal, NTN-F).

title: Get Data for Brazilian Bonds (Tesouro Direto)
code: # from CRAN (stable version) install.package('GetTDData')  # from github (development version) devtools::install_github('msperlin/GetTDData')

title: Get Data for Brazilian Bonds (Tesouro Direto)
text: Suppose need financial data (prices yields) bond type LTN maturity (end contract) 2023-01-01. bullet bond basic debt contract Brazilian government issues. pay value (coupon) lifetime pay 1000 R$ maturity. order get data, need run following code R: Let’s plot prices check code worked:
code: library(GetTDData)  assets <- 'LTN'   # Identifier of assets  first_year <- 2020 last_year <- 2022  df_td <- td_get(assets,                 first_year,                 last_year) #>  #> ── Downloading TD files #> ℹ Downloading 3 files in parallel... #> ✔ All downloads completed successfully. #>  #> ── Checking files #> ✔ Found 3 files #>  #> ── Reading files library(ggplot2) library(dplyr) #>  #> Attaching package: 'dplyr' #> The following objects are masked from 'package:stats': #>  #>     filter, lag #> The following objects are masked from 'package:base': #>  #>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union  # filter  LTN  my_asset_code <- "LTN 010123"  LTN <- df_td %>%   filter(asset_code  ==  my_asset_code)  p <- ggplot(data = LTN,              aes(x = as.Date(ref_date),                  y = price_bid,                  color = asset_code)) +    geom_line(linewidth = 1) + scale_x_date() + labs(title = '', x = 'Dates')  print(p)

title: Get Data for Brazilian Bonds (Tesouro Direto)
text: latest version GetTDData offers function get_yield_curve download current Brazilian yield curve directly Anbima. yield curve tool financial analysts show, based current prices fixed income instruments, market perceives future real, nominal inflation returns. can find details regarding use definition yield curve [Investopedia][https://www.investopedia.com/terms/y/yieldcurve.asp]. can plot desired result:
code: df_yield <- get_yield_curve()   str(df_yield) #> tibble [104 × 5] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame) #>  $ n_biz_days  : num [1:104] 252 252 252 378 378 378 504 504 504 630 ... #>  $ type        : chr [1:104] "real_return" "nominal_return" "implicit_inflation" "real_return" ... #>  $ value       : num [1:104] 7.09 13.57 6.05 7.56 13.83 ... #>  $ ref_date    : Date[1:104], format: "2027-09-01" "2027-09-01" ... #>  $ current_date: Date[1:104], format: "2026-08-28" "2026-08-28" ... library(ggplot2)  p <- ggplot(df_yield, aes(x=ref_date, y = value) ) +   geom_line(size=1) + geom_point() + facet_grid(~type, scales = 'free') +    labs(title = paste0('The current Brazilian Yield Curve '),        subtitle = paste0('Date: ', df_yield$current_date[1]))      #> Warning: Using `size` aesthetic for lines was deprecated in ggplot2 3.4.0. #> ℹ Please use `linewidth` instead. #> This warning is displayed once per session. #> Call `lifecycle::last_lifecycle_warnings()` to see where this warning was #> generated.  print(p)

text: function looks Tesouro Direto website (<https://www.tesourodireto.com.br/>) downloads files containing prices yields government bonds. can use input `asset_codes` restrict downloads specific bonds.

title: Downloads data for Brazilian government bonds directly from the website — td_get
code: td_get(   asset_codes = "LTN",   first_year = 2005,   last_year = as.numeric(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")),   dl_folder = get_cache_folder() )

title: Downloads data for Brazilian government bonds directly from the website — td_get
text: asset_codes character vector identifying assets (one ) names Excel files (e.g., 'LTN'). `NULL`, downloads available assets. first_year first year data (minimum 2005). last_year last year data. dl_folder Path folder save Excel files Tesouro Direto (create exist). Defaults session-temporary directory. avoid redownloading files across different R sessions, can pass persistent path (e.g., local folder path, using tools::R_user_dir("GetTDData", = "cache")).

Version 1.7.0 (2026-08-29)
text: restored fixed td_get_current() reliably fetch daily current prices yields Tesouro Direto using current-year asset files added get_asset_info() helper function providing bond metadata (indexer, coupon structure, descriptions) added visualization functions plot_yield_curve() plot_td_series() built ggplot2 added .rds file caching parsed Excel files accelerate data loading repeat reads added option user-persistent caching get_cache_folder() via tools::R_user_dir options(GetTDData.persistent_cache = TRUE) standardized function outputs (td_get(), get_yield_curve(), td_get_current()) return tibble data frames (tbl_df) updated get_td_names() support NTN-B1 (covering RendA+ Educa+ instruments) optional online CDN check fixed dead return(TRUE) statement td_get() guarded covr::in_covr() checks test suite prevent test failures covr package missing
